verdict.rationale: Rippling's own IAM page says its federated identity handles LDAP and RADIUS alongside AD, OIDC, SCIM and SAML. That is a first-party claim on this axis, but it is a single marketing sentence. It never says whether Rippling hosts cloud LDAP/RADIUS endpoints or merely federates with external directories. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of hosted cloud LDAP and RADIUS endpoints, setup guides for VPN/Wi-Fi/legacy-system authentication, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
